data: none: no data set enters this figure
figure: the relative error |line / actual - 1| of a straight line drawn through every second, third or fourth mode and read at the modes left out, against k: median and 95th percentile over the spectra, in three redshift bands
made_by: a check of the project outside this package; its script and the simulated spectra are not in this repository, so this figure cannot be redrawn from it
not_tested: the true spectrum between modes, the simulations' sample variance, the measurements' windows, correlated errors, the emulator
quantities: dimensionless ratios from the PRIYA simulations' spectra and published data errors; no spectrum value
spectra: the PRIYA simulations' own flux power (the total P1D) at their box modes: the low-resolution runs, every snapshot from z 2.2 to 4.6, every mean-flux level; no emulator and no measured spectrum
